titulo.alumno:
«Аспект в короткой истории»
Aspect in a short story

intro: Read the whole sequence and classify which verbs describe background, repetition and result; do not decide on a single adverb.

frases.estudio: Весь вечер шёл снег, а утром дороги уже очистили.
frases.alumno: It snowed all evening, and by morning the roads had already been cleared.

frases.estudio: Сначала мы искали адрес, потом нашли нужный подъезд.
frases.alumno: First we were looking for the address, then we found the right entrance.

piezas.titulo: An evening with a change of plan

frases.estudio: Пока Мария ждала автобус, она читала сообщение от коллеги.
frases.alumno: While María was waiting for the bus, she was reading a message from a colleague.

frases.estudio: В сообщении говорилось, что встречу перенесли на следующий день.
frases.alumno: The message said that the meeting had been moved to the following day.

frases.estudio: Мария позвонила в офис и уточнила новое время.
frases.alumno: María called the office and confirmed the new time.

frases.estudio: Затем она купила билет и поехала домой на метро.
frases.alumno: Then she bought a ticket and went home by metro.

frases.estudio: Вечером она закончила отчёт, который нужно было отправить утром.
frases.alumno: In the evening she finished the report that had to be sent in the morning.

piezas.titulo: Read the whole sequence and classify which verbs describe background, repetition and result; do not decide on a single adverb.
texto: Read the whole sequence and classify which verbs describe background, repetition and result; do not decide on a single adverb.
A narrative can alternate both aspects in a single sentence and change focus as the story moves on.

pregunta.texto: Which verb presents the discovery as a single result?

opciones.explicacion: Нашли is perfective and closes the search with a result.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Весь вечер шёл снег, а утром дороги уже очистили.»

frase.texto: Весь вечер шёл снег, а утром дороги уже очистили.

opciones.texto: It snowed all evening, and by morning the roads had already been cleared.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: First we were looking for the address, then we found the right entrance.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: Сначала мы искали адрес, потом нашли нужный подъезд

piezas.traduccion: First we were looking for the address, then we found the right entrance.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.

pregunta.texto: Which actions form the background of the story?

opciones.explicacion: Ждала and читала present activities in progress.

opciones.texto: To call and to buy the ticket.

Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: When did the report have to be sent?

opciones.explicacion: The last sentence places the sending in the morning.
